extracted.intended_audience: dealers and buyers of interior/exterior doors (wholesale/retail)
extracted.subtask_description: A dealers' product/catalog price list for interior and exterior doors describing sizes, materials, construction details, quality grades, options, and pricing adjustments/surcharges. Intended to guide ordering and pricing decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material and panel construction descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies materials and panel construction for each line: e.g., 'Pine Stiles and Rails. Three Ply Birch Flat Panels.', 'Solid Fir Stiles and Rails. 3-Ply Fir Flat Panels.', 'Pine Stiles and Rails. Three Ply Fir Flat Panels.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify which door lines are pine, fir or veneered and whether panels are one-piece, three-ply birch/fir, or veneered; often paired with model names (KLIMAX, VERIBEST, FIR).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality grade classification (No. 1, No. 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Doors and designs are offered in quality grades such as 'No. 1 Quality' or 'No. 2 Quality' and 'No. 1 AND NO. 2 QUALITY'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality grade affects which stock sizes and prices apply; multiple entries throughout the list indicate different prices for No.1 vs No.2 where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stiles and rails dimensional specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Design-specific dimensional specs given for stiles/top rail/lock rail/bottom rail — e.g., 'Stiles and Top Rail, 4%"; Lock Rail, 8"; Bottom Rail, 12"' or 'Stiles and Top Rail 5J4", Bottom Rail 11%"'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dimensions are listed per design and are part of the product spec (used for ordering and matching hardware/fit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stock sizes and panel-count rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists stock door sizes (width x height) and includes notes mapping size to panel counts: e.g., 'Note: Doors 1-6 wide have only 4 panels, 1 wide 4 high to match the 8 panel doors.' and 'Doors under 2-0 wide have only 4 panels...'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates how panel layout changes with narrow widths; important for visual matching across openings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundle quantities and full-bundle ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to bundle quantities: 'See Page 3 for Full Bundle Quantities.'; some surcharges/discount rules depend on bundle sizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ordering, pricing, and per-bundle surcharges depend on full-bundle quantities which are specified elsewhere (page 3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Surcharge for orders under full bundle
rubrics_metrics.description: Any Order for Less than Full Bundles of Six Doors of a Size — Add per Bundle $1.30.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies a per-bundle surcharge when the order is smaller than the full bundle size (example uses six doors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantity discount rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit prohibition on quantity discounts for certain lines: 'NO QUANTITY DISCOUNT ALLOWED ON SCREEN DOORS' and repeats elsewhere for combination doors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that some product categories do not receive quantity-based discounts; must be observed when quoting large orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing for optional features and extras
rubrics_metrics.description: Adds and deductions for options: e.g., 'Glazed Bevel Plate Add to open door price $4.36', 'Glazed Bevel Plate Add to open door price $22.64', 'Glazed Bevel Plate Add to open door price $30.02', 'For Applying Mirror Moulding only (No Mirror Included) ... Add ... $5.00'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each optional feature (glazing, beveled plate, mirror moulding, sunk mirror arrangement, etc.) carries specified add-on charges; amounts vary by design and are listed alongside models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rabbeting for pairs surcharge
rubrics_metrics.description: Rabbeting Doors for Pairs $0.30 Per Pair Extra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Small fixed surcharge applied when doors are rabbeted for paired installation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crating and packing charges
rubrics_metrics.description: Crating fees specified: e.g., 'Crating Single Door Add per Door $2.00', '3 Doors to Bundle ... .76', '6 ... .50', and 'Crating Garage Doors Extra $2.00 Per Pair or Set or Less'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Crating is an extra charge per door/pair/set with bundle rates indicated; include when preparing total cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Made-to-order indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain items are marked '★ made to order.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items so marked are not stock and will be manufactured to order; expect different lead times and possibly different pricing/terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moulding construction method
rubrics_metrics.description: Construction note: 'The mouldings are COPED — NOT MITERED.' and 'There are no NAIL HOLES to disfigure the surface.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies workmanship/finish method intended to affect appearance and fit; indicates coping is used for moulding joints and that finished surfaces are free of nail holes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fitting allowance policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Pricing/ordering note: 'If Storm Sash, ordered open, deduct $1.00 per door. Necessary Allowance Made for Fitting.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates pricing deductions for certain factory-assembled options and that allowance for fitting (clearances, trimming) is accounted for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mirror application and mirror bevel specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Details for mirror doors: 'Our Beveled Mirrors Have 134 in. Bevel.' and charges such as 'Mirror Attached to Door ... $26.48 ...' and add-on fees for applying moulding only or arranging sunk mirror.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies mirror bevel spec and separate charges for mirror, moulding application, and arranging doors for sunk mirrors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Glass-size-based price adjustments
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjustments for glass sizing deviations: e.g., 'For above Doors with Glass Sizes (Add for 1 y8" $0.51 4 inches shorter Add for $0.55)' and other similar per-inch or size adjustments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When glass openings differ from the standard size, small per-inch charges/deductions are applied; amounts vary by design and are listed near each design block.

rubrics_metrics.name: Items/parts explicitly not included and add-on stool/cap charges
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes stating 'Above Prices do not Include Stool' and 'If Stool is Wanted Add $ .50' and similar notes 'Stool and Blocks Not Included. If Stool and Blocks Wanted Add $1.00'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some finishing trim pieces (stool, cap, blocks) are excluded from listed prices and must be added at specified charges when requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of materials in price
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit inclusions: e.g., 'Prices include Galvanoid Wire and Glass inserted.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tells buyer which materials or inserts are already included in the listed price to avoid double-charging or incorrect quotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: No freight allowance on certain items
rubrics_metrics.description: Shipping policy statements such as 'No Freight Allowance on Blinds or Shutters.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that freight costs for these items are not discounted or credited by the seller and should be charged to buyer.

rubrics_metrics.name: No quantity discount on specified categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeated policy: 'No quantity discount allowed on Combination Doors.' and 'No quantity discount allowed on screen doors.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affirms that some product categories are not eligible for quantity-based price reductions; included here as a separate explicit rule for different categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Panel/feature substitution or 'Our Option' notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Phrases like 'Pine or Birch Panels Our Option' and 'Glass Size ... Our Option' appear throughout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates manufacturer/supplier may substitute panel material or choose among options at their discretion; buyer should confirm if a specific option is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design-specific feature notes (e.g., 'doors under 2-0 wide have only 3 panels')
rubrics_metrics.description: Design notes that alter standard specs based on size: e.g., 'NOTE: Doors under 2-0 wide have only 3 panels, 1 wide 3 high to match the 6 panel doors.' and similar size-dependent panel counts for 4/6/8-panel sets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are design-specific exceptions affecting appearance and must be checked when matching existing door patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grating/additional surcharges for screen doors and small orders
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules like 'GRATING Any Order for Less than Full Bundles of Six Doors of a Size — Add per Bundle $1.30' and 'NO QUANTITY DISCOUNT ALLOWED ON SCREEN DOORS'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies additional per-bundle charges (grating) and reiterates discount policies for screen doors; relevant when ordering non-standard quantities.
